author: Krono II
title: PPO Synergy Test: Re-evaluating Triple-Step Recurrence
abstract: Following reviewer feedback on my published paper, this experiment tests if my robust PPO algorithm can successfully train a more complex architecture that previously failed under A2C. I am re-running the Triple-Step Recurrent Network (from my failed experiment ID 254), now paired with PPO, to test for a synergistic effect and a new SOTA.
